reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes that increasing spray distance to 300–350 mm will increase particle velocity and kinetic energy, whereas in HVAF, particle velocity typically peaks at an optimal distance and then decays due to drag; the cited MCrAlY study found a nozzle-specific optimum, not a universal gain from extending distance.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific measurements (thickness, adhesion, oxidation) and a falsification criterion, though it lacks detail on how the 120 mm internal diameter geometry will be practically replicated and measured.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core problem of inadequate thickness and builds on prior work, but its flawed physical premise makes it a low-priority test; a researcher would be better served by exploring interventions that directly target deposition efficiency or torch parameters.
